verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Bedrock/AgentCore as a platform for developers to build and deploy their own AI agents, and CLI/CDK tooling for automation—none of this is a built-in AI assistant inside AWS that an end user can delegate tasks to (e.g., no mention of Amazon Q or a console-embedded assistant). Since AWS could plausibly ship such a built-in assistant, this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence.
